auditScope: Independent visual-only revision audit; only this report is written. Original HTTP/STOP and usage describe the existing recordings, not new requests.

listeningReview.note: Audio content, pronunciation, missing words, spoken directions and naturalness were not listened to or recognized by this audit. The revision preserves the original audio exactly.

limitations: Response JSON bodies are not retained; responsePayloadSha256 cannot be independently recomputed. HTTP 200/STOP are checked as matching recorded provenance across original audit, journal, raw metadata and runtime results.
No-new-dispatch verification relies on attemptedThisRun=0, all reusedRaw=true and byte-identical paid attempt journal; this audit did not independently observe network traffic.
The 1.0 speed claim checks selected synthesis settings and unchanged WAV payloads, without subjective assessment of speaking rate.
